summary: 2 blocking findings are valid and should be repaired in spec.json. Both findings point to missing implementation sources for required contract evidence.

items.title: Override evidence has no capture/persistence path and the no-new-CLI constraint forbids adding one
items.rationale: The spec requires override completion in real flow paths but does not name where OverrideCompletionEvidence is stored or read. The no-new-CLI constraint means the repair must specify an artifact path or existing state field instead of adding a command option.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements R3-R5 mention OverrideCompletionEvidence and `flow set step <id> done`; constraints forbid new user-facing CLI options; no spec field names the override evidence artifact path.

items.title: impl-gate is a mandatory contract target but has no persisted verdict artifact and run-gate.js is not a listed converter
items.rationale: The spec includes impl-gate in the contract target set but does not identify a durable impl-gate verdict artifact. The repair must add run-gate.js to scope and define the persisted gate judgment artifact path read by validators.
items.evidence: spec.json R2 and R6 include impl-gate; overview module list omits `src/flow/lib/run-gate.js`; current review states gate verdict is only in the command envelope without a named artifactPath.
